verdict_rationale: CI is RED: cargo-fmt and cargo-clippy jobs in pr-tests workflow both FAILED on the new oya-check-eu-ai-act-annex-iii-refusal/src/lib.rs file. Verified locally: cargo fmt --check exit=1 (rustfmt drift in lines 193, 351, 475, 511, 570). cargo clippy -p oya-check-eu-ai-act-annex-iii-refusal -- -D warnings exit=101 (result_large_err triggered by EuAiActAnnexIiiRefusalViolation in Result return; struct exceeds 128 bytes). These are absolute merge blockers under the governance-pipeline admission gate.

ADR-0145 reform created an enforcement-debt gap: the ADR declares mandatory enforcement crates (oya-shared-audit-chain-client-kernel, oya-shared-tracing-client-kernel, oya-check-otel-trace-propagation, oya-check-ontology-projection-coverage, oya-check-audit-chain-seal-coverage) and a mandatory manifest field (ontology_projections), but NONE of these landed in this PR. Result: the reform is documented but unenforced — the universal-mediator rule is retired with no replacement substrate guarantees in place.

604 references to retired symbols (ADR-0140 / ADR-0141 / feedback_workflow_objectgraph_adapter_layer) still appear in microservices/ files. ADR-0145 §Operational explicitly states ADR-0140 + ADR-0141 are SUBSUMED and the feedback memory is SUPERSEDED. Networkpolicy comments + PRD bridges still cite the retired authorities, creating a doc-vs-decision drift that will mislead readers and downstream agents.

Combined with the open `bypass-violations-reclassified` claim (which IS correct under the new rule), the PR cannot honestly merge until: (a) CI green, (b) reform-enforcement crates land OR ADR-0145 is amended to defer them under a tracked IP, (c) the 604 retired-citation cleanup is performed OR an explicit phased-cleanup IP is filed.

findings.summary: HyperscalerMetrics trait in oya-shared-hyperscaler-metrics-kernel exposes 7 methods (record_capability_circuit_state, record_capability_retry_budget_exhausted, record_responses_429, record_responses_5xx, record_responses_total, record_request_success, record_request_total). The canonical PrometheusRule will likely require additional metrics (e.g. shuffle-sharding violations, bulkhead-saturation) — these will force a major-version bump per [[no-silent-regression]].
findings.suggestion: Add a default-method strategy: declare each method as `fn method(&self, …) { /* noop default */ }` so adding methods is non-breaking. Alternatively, segment the trait into HyperscalerMetricsCore + HyperscalerMetricsExtended to bound the breaking surface.

findings.summary: EuAiActAnnexIiiRefusalViolation struct is >128 bytes (5 String fields + enum). Returning it as the Err of Result<_, _> triggers clippy::result_large_err. Apart from the lint, this is also a perf concern (every Ok path pays the size).
